data.name: GunHero
data.detailed_description:
Nova atualização

GunHero now has Steam Workshop support! You can create, play and rate custom levels using the in-game level editor & level browser!


Acerca do jogo

Fight your way through multiple environments filled with traps and obstacles, each more dangerous and deadly than the last. Shoot bullets and throw grenades at your enemies while releasing prisoners from their cages. You are the hero this evil-filled world needs.

GunHero is a 2D-action-platformer-shooter filled with handcrafted levels set in various environments, where each one contains its own unique dangers. Your task is simple: save the world from the evil Count Darkcape.

  • Shoot your way through enemy troops, pick up weapons from your dead foes, yield destruction with your grenades and become victorious with the help of your shield! But don't forget about the prisoners and hostages that desperately need your help!
  • Watch out for the deadly traps and obstacles! Spike balls are much harder to dodge than you'd think, and is there anything more dangerous than a huge blade? Well, maybe a spinning laser beam, or a missile launcher. You can travel on rotating and moving platforms, climb ladders or fly using the large propellers. Just don't get trapped on the roof of an elevator as death by getting crushed between an elevator and a wall is not a pleasant death.
  • Having trouble? Could the world maybe use a few heroes more? Just invite a few of your favorite friends over for some good old-fashioned couch co-op! Enemies won't stand a chance against you.

Feature Breakdown


  • Over 100 handcrafted levels set in six different environments
  • Multiple weapons to choose from
  • Grenades and explosions
  • Loot, health and ammo boxes to help you
  • Fast, satisfying combat with permanent blood decals
  • Multiple enemy types, including generals, bazooka men and grenadiers
  • Laser beams, elevators and missile launchers
  • Awesome and intense boss fights
  • Double jumping and ladder climbing
  • Powerup shield to block incoming damage
  • Propellers, blade spinners and tanks
  • Ferris wheels, lava and spike balls
  • Flame traps, trampolines and fireball cannons
  • Cool world map to help track your progress
  • Achievements and cloud saves
  • Difficulty settings to match your skill level
  • Couch co-op with friends
  • Keyboard and mouse support
  • Game controller support
  • Fully remappable controls

reviews.review:
GunHero is a side-scrolling action platformer developed and published by Olli-Samuli Lehmus that embraces the spirit of old-school arcade shooters while adding enough modern conveniences to keep the experience enjoyable today. Rather than focusing on an elaborate storyline, the game places its attention squarely on fast-paced gameplay, challenging platforming, and satisfying combat. Players take on the role of a determined hero who must battle through dangerous territories to rescue prisoners and ultimately confront the villainous Count Darkcape. The premise is intentionally simple, allowing the game's mechanics and level design to carry the experience from beginning to end.

The campaign is packed with over one hundred handcrafted stages spread across six distinct worlds, giving players a lengthy adventure filled with variety. Each area introduces new environmental hazards that constantly change the pace, from spinning blades and laser barriers to elevators, missile launchers, lava pits, trampolines, flame traps, and other deadly obstacles. Every level is carefully designed to test both reflexes and timing, encouraging players to observe their surroundings instead of rushing forward carelessly. The gradual increase in difficulty feels natural, introducing fresh mechanics at a comfortable pace before combining them into more demanding challenges later in the game. This thoughtful progression keeps the adventure engaging while rewarding persistence and improving player skill.

Combat remains straightforward but consistently entertaining. GunHero equips players with firearms, grenades, and several weapon options that allow different approaches to enemy encounters. Standard soldiers are joined by stronger opponents such as bazooka troops, grenadiers, and commanding officers, each requiring players to adjust their strategy rather than relying on the same tactics throughout the campaign. Boss battles add another layer of excitement by emphasizing movement, attack patterns, and patience. Along the way, players can collect health packs, ammunition, shields, and various loot drops that provide valuable assistance without removing the challenge. The action is complemented by satisfying explosions and permanent blood effects that reinforce the game's arcade-inspired style without becoming the main attraction.

Movement plays an equally important role in the overall experience. Responsive controls make jumping, climbing ladders, and using the double jump feel smooth and reliable, allowing players to navigate complex platforming sections with confidence. Success depends heavily on precision, especially during later stages where environmental hazards and enemy attacks overlap. Thankfully, multiple difficulty settings make the game approachable for newcomers while still offering a satisfying test for players seeking a greater challenge. The world map also provides a clear sense of progression, making each completed level feel like a meaningful step toward the final confrontation.

One of GunHero's most impressive features is its long-term replay value. Beyond the substantial single-player campaign, the game includes local cooperative play, allowing two players to tackle the action together. Even more significant is the integrated level editor and Steam Workshop support, which enable players to create, share, download, and rate custom levels created by the community. These additions greatly extend the game's lifespan by offering an endless stream of new content beyond the official campaign. Additional features such as controller support, fully customizable controls, cloud saves, and Steam achievements further round out an already content-rich package.

Visually, GunHero relies on colorful pixel art that captures the charm of classic platform shooters without attempting to imitate modern high-end graphics. Character sprites and environments remain easy to read during hectic firefights, ensuring gameplay clarity is never sacrificed for visual effects. The soundtrack and sound design effectively support the game's energetic pace, helping maintain excitement throughout extended play sessions. While the presentation may not be groundbreaking, it fits the game's retro-inspired identity and complements its action-focused design.

GunHero succeeds by delivering exactly what it promises: an old-fashioned run-and-gun adventure filled with carefully designed levels, responsive controls, rewarding combat, and plenty of replay value. It does not reinvent the genre or rely on cinematic storytelling, but instead focuses on polished mechanics and consistent gameplay that remain enjoyable from beginning to end. Fans of classic action platformers will likely appreciate its emphasis on skill, exploration, and handcrafted content, while the cooperative mode and community-created levels ensure there is always another challenge waiting after the main campaign is complete.

Rating: 7/10
